title: Duʿāʾ of Complaining Weakness to Allah
arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ إِلَيْكَ أَشْكُوْ ضَعْفَ قُوَّتِيْ وَقِلَّةَ حِيْلَتِيْ وَهَوَانِيْ عَلَى النَّاسِ يَا أَرْحَمَ الرَّاحِمِيْنَ أَنْتَ رَبُّ الْمُسْتَضْعَفِيْنَ وَأَنْتَ رَبِّيْ
transliteration: Allāhumma ilayka ashkū ḍaʿfa quwwatī wa qillata ḥīlatī wa hawānī ʿalan-nāsi yā Arḥamar-Rāḥimīn, anta Rabbul-mustaḍʿafīn wa anta Rabbī
translation: To You, my Lord, I complain of my weakness, lack of support and the humiliation I am made to receive. Most Compassionate and Merciful! You are the Lord of the weak, and you are my Lord.
reference: Prophet Muhammad's supplication in Ta'if (Seerah reference)
